profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Disney | Author of Platform Engineering for AI | AIOps | Infrastructure Engineering
profile.summary:
I build platforms that empower engineers to engineer at scale.
Currently, I am a Principal Software Engineer at The Walt Disney Company, leading engineering teams focused on AIOps and data platform engineering. We design and operate the infrastructure that keeps data pipelines, ML models, and observability systems running smoothly on Kubernetes and cloud platforms. My ultimate goal is to make the complex machinery behind the magic completely invisible, allowing creators to focus on the experience rather than the underlying infrastructure.
Prior to Disney, I led technology and data-driven transformations at IBM, Red Hat, and LTK. During my tenure at IBM, I was elected to the IBM Academy of Technology and received the Outstanding Technical Achievement Award.
Throughout my career, I have learned that the hardest problems in platform engineering are rarely technical, they are rooted in organizational dynamics and the need for a mindset shift. Earning a team's trust to abandon their handcrafted workflows, or building reusable systems that solve actual problems rather than imagined ones, is difficult work. Getting it wrong is expensive. Getting it right is the difference between a platform people merely tolerate and one they champion.
I distilled these lessons into my book, Platform Engineering for Artificial Intelligence — https://lnkd.in/eAGrEweh — a guide grounded in the practical realities of operating AI platforms.
While I hold certifications including AWS Machine Learning Specialty, IBM Architect Profession Level 2, and PMP, my core belief is that what you successfully ship into production teaches you far more than any exam.
I regularly write about software architecture, platform engineering, and the messy reality of shipping AI systems at https://spiritedengineering.net.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Infrastructure/Platform Engineering. Automate the process of creating Magic: Leading a team of experts in the field of AIOps and Data platform development. My team is responsible for building machine learning models as well as a robust Data platform using cutting-edge technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Superset, etc utilizing Kubernetes on Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, G cloud)
positions.insights: Computer Science, Distributed Systems and +13 skills

positions.title: Director of Engineering, Data
positions.description:
Provide leadership and mentorship to the team, fostering a culture of learning and growth.
Team up with other leaders to develop and implement the overall data platform strategy, including data architecture, data governance, and data management.
Lead and manage a team of data engineers, data scientists to design, develop, and maintain the data platform.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as product, analytics, and business, to understand data requirements and ensure they are met by the data platform.
Ensure the data platform is secure, compliant, and scalable to meet the needs of the organization.
Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends in data management and data engineering and evaluate potential new technologies and tools to incorporate into the platform.
Oversee the performance of the data platform and work with the team to troubleshoot and resolve any issues.
Develop and manage the budget for the data platform, including cloud platforms, software, and staffing costs.
Work with other leaders to define and implement good practices for data quality, data integration, and data warehousing.
Promote a culture of data-driven decision making within the organization.
Ensure the data platform is able to handle the high-performance, large-scale data analysis, and data processing.
Work closely with the IT and security teams to ensure the data platform meets all necessary security and compliance requirements.
Develop and maintain data-related policies and procedures.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, IBM Academy Of Technology member
positions.description:
Lead the design and development of software solutions for advanced cluster management on OpenShift, with a focus on analytics and data-driven insights.
Work closely with the product and development teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical designs.
Write and maintain high-quality, maintainable, and testable code.
Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends in cluster management and analytics and evaluate potential new technologies and tools to incorporate into the software.
Write and maintain documentation for the software, including user guides, installation instructions, and API documentation.
Participate in code reviews and ensure that the software adheres to coding standards and best practices.
Participate in agile development process, taking part in sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
Contribute to the development of the team's technical roadmap and work with the team to prioritize features and enhancements.
Contribute to the development and implementation of the architectural vision, ensuring that it aligns with the company's overall strategy and goals.
Work closely with the OpenShift development team to ensure compatibility and integration with the core platform
Help to promote the use of OpenShift and related technologies with customers and partners, through events, webinars, and other initiatives.

patents.title: Tag-driven scheduling of computing resources for function execution
patents.description: An embodiment includes extracting, by a scheduler, function-tag data associated with a function identified by a deployment request. The embodiment also includes selecting, by the scheduler, a computing device within a server cluster to host the function based at least in part on a comparison of the function-tag data and host-tag data associated with the computing device. The embodiment also includes issuing, by the scheduler, an instruction to the computing device, wherein the issuing of the instruction causes an allocation of resources for hosting execution of the function.

patents.title: Adjusting eraser size in drawing applications
patents.description: The method includes identifying, by one or more computer processors, a first location and a second location of input on a touch-sensitive surface. The method further includes calculating, by one or more computer processors, a distance between the first location and the second location. The method further includes identifying, by one or more computer processors, a first elapsed time between creation of the identified first location of input and the identified second location of input. The method further includes calculating, by one or more computer processors, a first size of an eraser based upon the identified first elapsed time. The method further includes generating, by one or more computer processors, an eraser path based upon the identified first location and the identified second location of input on a touch-sensitive surface, and the calculated first size of an eraser.
